_comment: Configuration for the TCP/53 block watch. Every value can be overridden from the command line; see Start-Tcp53Watch.ps1 -?.
_probe_comment: The cheap per-cycle transaction. A small A record so a healthy answer fits one datagram over either transport.
_impact_comment: The query used to prove real-world damage. A root DNSKEY answer is far larger than 512 bytes, so the server sets the TC bit over UDP and the client is REQUIRED to retry over TCP. If TCP/53 is blocked this name cannot be resolved at all.
_control_comment: A non-DNS TCP port on the same server. If it connects while 53 does not, the filtering rule selects on port 53 rather than on the host.

Targets.Name: Gateway
Targets.Note: The local router. Probed because it is the first device able to filter; a router that runs no DNS forwarder reports DnsServerUnreachable, which is not a block.
